page.layout: One column of names, left of centre, with years beside it in the left margin and horizontal rules between groups. Right margin: three side notes beside the 1437, 1438 and 1440 groups. Printed page number at top right. Signature mark at foot.

main_text.l: Lubbert Lewe. Transactio civitatis Gro-ning. cum Hamburg. & pax reddita Houwerdzie & Epponi Gockinge.
1438 | Hindrick Cater. Transactio specialis cum Ailcone Houverda, de arce Muntensi.
1440 | Ludeken Evert Wigboldes. Transactio nova cum li-beris Ailconis Houverdæ & eius uxore.

page.notes: The years 1436–1442 sit in the left margin beside their groups; I have placed each year on the first line of its group. The signature "§ 5" is partly faded and the last character is doubtful. The side notes are small and partly rubbed; "Houwerdzie" and "Gockinge" are read from a faint impression. Printed hyphens are kept at the line ends in the side notes.
